# tracked_entries { #crossrepo.gitutil.tracked_entries }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.tracked_entries(repo, subdir)
```

List everything tracked at HEAD under a directory, symbolic links included.

Only tracked files are reported, so untracked scratch output sitting in a
results directory is invisible to the catalog: committing a file is the act
of publishing it.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree to inspect, on this machine or another.

<code>[**subdir**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[str](`str`), [Sequence](`typing.Sequence`)\[[str](`str`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Pathspec limiting the listing, for example ``:(icase)results``, or several of them, in which case a file matching any is listed.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [int](`int`), [str](`str`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A mapping of repository-relative path to ``(blob_sha, size, mode)``. A mode of `LINK_MODE` marks a symbolic link, whose blob holds the target path rather than any content and whose size is the length of that path.
